name: Onyx Protocol empty-market rounding
summary: The freshly listed oPEPE market could be redeemed down to two wei of supply, while direct PEPE transfers increased cash without minting shares. This inflated the exchange rate used for collateral, and redeemUnderlying's integer division then burned only one wei to recover the donation, allowing the attacker to borrow the other Onyx markets nearly empty and recycle the manipulated collateral.
notes: The oPEPE delegator was deployed with the older defect-bearing implementation selected in its constructor; the implementation pointer remained unchanged through both exploit transactions.

MetaTrust reports approximately 1,156.9 ETH-equivalent ($2.088 million) from the anchor transaction and another $60,000 of MATIC, UNI, APE, USDP, and WETH in the follow-up transaction, for approximately $2.14 million gross across the incident. The structured WETH component records the anchor transaction's post-swap profit; exact per-token amounts for the follow-up are not published.
The $2.14 million incident loss is reported across two exploit transactions; exact per-token gross outflows for the $60,000 follow-up are not published in the cited analysis.
